name: Linear Bounding Volume Hierarchy (LBVH) for Volume Rendering
definition: A hierarchical data structure for sparse volume rendering with empty space skipping, adapted from surface ray tracing LBVH to uniform grids, targeting GPU implementation via CUDA.
summary: LBVH is a GPU-friendly hierarchical data structure for sparse volume rendering that prioritizes fast construction via Morton-ordered middle-split heuristics over the superior culling of SAH-based methods.
